plan.purpose: High-concurrency round 1, SM-cost plane: TileLang R tiling with batch tiles BM > 16 (rows per CTA per step, WGMMA N), qualified at the M0 + M6 standard plus bitwise agreement with BM = 16; then, for C requests of 128 tokens arriving together (C = 256, 1024; D = 256, 768; LSTM and sLSTM), split-0 selection among s0, s0p_default, every BM = 16 configuration at B = C and the qualified BM > 16 configurations, and split-1 paired timing of the best against s0p_default (headline), against the best BM = 16 configuration (plane attribution) and against s0 at C = 1024 (latency)
deviations: v2 of run HC1 v1: cluster BM = 128 removed; sanitizer on the largest remaining cluster tile; a sanitizer finding now excludes its configuration instead of stopping the batch
plan.stop_criterion: at C = 1024 for D = 256 and D = 768, LSTM and sLSTM: throughput >= 2x max(s0, s0p) and P90 no worse than s0
plan.node_reason: One H100 node (4 H100): qualification lanes in parallel, then selection and paired timing per lane
not_claimed: arrival processes other than a closed batch

concurrent_lanes: four GPU lanes timed concurrently on one node, each pinned to GPU-local cores
